info.title: Hukamnama · Sri Harmandir Sahib — public API
info.description: The daily Hukamnama from Sri Harmandir Sahib, Amritsar, as JSON. Each day is located by Ang from the Hukamnama SGPC publishes; every line is then read from the verbatim Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji corpus and proved against `range_sha256` before it is served. Gurbani Soul is not affiliated with SGPC. Free, with no key and no account; open to any origin (CORS); every `200` carries an `ETag`. Dates are dates in Amritsar (UTC+05:30). Version 1 only grows: fields may be added, and none is renamed or removed without twelve months' notice. Best effort, with no guarantee of availability: late rather than wrong. Generated by tools/gen_hukamnama_openapi.py; every response schema is inferred from what the service and the Worker really answer.

tags.name: Hukamnama
tags.description: The day's Hukamnama, past days, and the list of published days.

get.description: The Hukamnama for the current date in Amritsar (UTC+05:30), wherever the request comes from. Before it is published, usually until about 05:30 in the morning there, the answer is `pending` and names the latest published date. A day is never served under another day's date.

200.description: Today's Hukamnama, or a pending answer.

ETag.description: A strong validator. Send it back in `If-None-Match`; an unchanged answer is `304` with no body.

Cache-Control.description: `public, max-age=60` when published; `public, max-age=30` when pending.

429.description: Too many requests from one address. Wait for the seconds in `Retry-After`.

503.description: The API cannot read its files right now. Nothing is served rather than something unproved.

get.description: One day, by its date in Amritsar. A day with no published Hukamnama answers `pending`. A date after today in Amritsar, or before the archive begins, is `404`.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: The day in Amritsar, YYYY-MM-DD: from 2026-11-01 up to today there.

200.description: That day's Hukamnama, or a pending answer.

ETag.description: A strong validator. Send it back in `If-None-Match`; an unchanged answer is `304` with no body.

Cache-Control.description: `public, max-age=3600, s-maxage=86400` for a past day; a pending answer is `public, max-age=30`.

400.description: The date is not a real date in YYYY-MM-DD form.

404.description: The date is after today in Amritsar, or before 2026-11-01.

429.description: Too many requests from one address. Wait for the seconds in `Retry-After`.

503.description: The API cannot read its files right now. Nothing is served rather than something unproved.

get.description: The latest published days, newest first, never a day ahead of the date in Amritsar. Without `include=lines` each day comes without its lines.

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: `lines` adds every line of each day (and the English layer where it is included).

ETag.description: A strong validator. Send it back in `If-None-Match`; an unchanged answer is `304` with no body.

400.description: `limit` is not a whole number from 1 to 30.

429.description: Too many requests from one address. Wait for the seconds in `Retry-After`.

503.description: The API cannot read its files right now. Nothing is served rather than something unproved.

get.description: Every published day, newest first, with its date, Ang, raag, author and hash, without the text. What an archive page or a sitemap lists.

ETag.description: A strong validator. Send it back in `If-None-Match`; an unchanged answer is `304` with no body.

429.description: Too many requests from one address. Wait for the seconds in `Retry-After`.

503.description: The API cannot read its files right now. Nothing is served rather than something unproved.

amritsar_date.description: The day this Hukamnama belongs to, in Amritsar (UTC+05:30). Show this date, never the reader's.

ang.description: The Ang the shabad opens on.

first_line_id.description: The corpus id of the first line of the range.

last_line_id.description: The corpus id of the last line of the range.

comp_id.description: The corpus id of the composition the opening verse belongs to.

opening_line_id.description: The corpus id of the first verse (the line after any heading).

opening_translit.description: The first verse in the corpus's rule-based transliteration.

line_count.description: How many lines the range holds, headings included.

range_sha256.description: SHA-256 of every line's `gurmukhi` joined by a newline (UTF-8). Check it before showing the text.

scripture_sha256.description: The fingerprint of the edition of the text the lines were read from.

citation.description: The citation to show with the text: “Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji · Ang N”.

published_at.description: When the day was published here, in UTC, without fractional seconds.

credit.description: How the day was located and where its text is from.

ang_end.description: The Ang the shabad ends on.

raag.description: The raag of the opening verse, as the corpus names it.

author.description: The author, when every verse of the day has the same one; `null` when they differ, as in a Vaar.

attribution.description: The credit to show wherever the Hukamnama appears, with its link.

lines.description: Every line of the range, in order.

translation.description: Present only when the lines carry `en`: whose translation it is.

rahao_gurmukhi.description: Present only when the shabad has exactly one rahao (refrain): its lines, verbatim, in order. Absent when there is none or more than one; nothing is guessed.

corrected_at.description: Present only when the day's range was corrected after it was published: when, in UTC. `published_at` stays the first publication.

id.description: The corpus id of the line.

ang.description: The Ang the line is on.

gurmukhi.description: The line, verbatim. Never alter, shorten or re-space it.

translit.description: A rule-based transliteration: a reading aid, not the text.

is_heading.description: True for a heading line (a raag or author heading), false for a verse.

en.description: Dr. Sant Singh Khalsa's English translation of the line, when the English layer is included. A separate, labelled layer: never present it as the Gurbani.

amritsar_date.description: The day asked for, in Amritsar.

status.description: Always `pending` here: no Hukamnama is published for this day (not yet, or it was held back).

scripture_sha256.description: The fingerprint of the edition of the text the published days were read from; `null` before any day is published.

expected_by.description: 05:30 in Amritsar on that day, in UTC: about when a day's Hukamnama first appears.

latest.description: The most recent published date, or `null` when there is none.

scripture_sha256.description: The fingerprint of the edition of the text; `null` before any day is published.

latest.description: The most recent published date, or `null` when there is none.

days.description: Every published day up to today in Amritsar, newest first.

ang.description: The Ang the shabad opens on.

raag.description: The raag of the opening verse.

author.description: The day's single author, or `null` when its verses have more than one.

line_count.description: How many lines the day holds.

range_sha256.description: The hash that proves the day's lines.

published_at.description: When the day was published here, in UTC.

corrected_at.description: Present only when the day was corrected after it was published: when, in UTC.

items.description: The latest published days, newest first. Each is a Hukamnama; `lines` and `translation` are present only with `include=lines`.

ok.description: True when the API could read its files.

status_today.description: `published` once today's Hukamnama is here, else `pending`.

latest.description: The most recent published date, or `null` when there is none.

scripture_sha256.description: The fingerprint of the edition of the text; `null` before any day is published.

paused.description: True while the service is paused by its owner: every day then reads as `pending`.

error.description: What went wrong, in a few words.

request_id.description: An id to quote when reporting a problem.
